book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso jɛmɛ Nikodɛmu le kune boyɛ chi kinfɛɛ
Muh ŋgoo yi Bafalashii wumu gɛ̀ bee ba tɛŋe lɛ Nikodɛmu, wu gɛ̀ bee muh wu kinchvu ki bikwɛɛ bi woŋ wu Bajuu.

Muh wunɛ gɛ̀ ja wu to fɛ Jiso le antaŋ wu du wu le lɛ, “Labai, bee kee lɛ wo le muh wu n'yɛyɛ wù ja fɛ Nyo le, nje gɛ muh nyu yu wù taŋlo wu gee kfuu chi munɛ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo mù wo gee munɛ, njɛ Nyo le bɛ wu sɛŋ gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, njɛ ba boo muh mboyɛ wu fwɛŋ sɛŋ, tu gɛ mwɛdɛ nyu wu yɛŋ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le gɛ.”

content: Nikodɛmu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Taŋlo ba ge nɛɛ fɛ ba ka ba boo muh a wu ta wa? Taŋlo wu ka wu kaasɛ wu tu a bwee shɛŋ fɛ ba ka ba boo wu?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh nɛ baaŋ kɛme gɛ boyɛ chi joo bɛ chi Kiyo gɛ, tu gɛ taŋlo wu lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le gɛ.
Muh wu wuŋ boyi muh wu wuŋ, Kiyo boyi kiyo.
Keefɛ jwe yûne wo lɛ nle njɛmɛ wo le lɛ ba kɛme ki ba boo bɛŋ bachii mboyɛ wù fwɛŋ gɛ.
Fii to yi fede gɛh no yi koŋe, wo yuge no yi fede, geenɛ gɛ taŋlo wo sɛɛŋ laa yi jade faaŋ, yi gɛɛne faaŋ la. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi le fɛ muh wù kɛme wa boyɛ chi Kiyo le.”

content: Nikodɛmu mo wu ghaa lɛ, “Taŋlo finɛ fiɛɛ jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ la?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le muh wu n'yɛyɛ wu bamii ba Ishwala, wo kee gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ gɛ?
Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, bee jɛme fiɛɛ nyu fì bee kee, bee bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa nyu fiɛɛ fì nyu fi bee le bee yɛŋ wa, geenɛ gɛ bɛŋ bɛmɛ fiɛɛ fì bee jɛme le gɛ.
Nɛ nsɛŋe bɛŋ mwɛɛ nyu mu yi nshɛŋ le fɛnɛ njɛ bɛŋ bɛmɛ lo sɛŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jîɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ bɛɛŋ mu nsɛŋe nyu mu woŋ wù Nyo le?
Gɛ muh nyu yu wu le wu bɛɛŋ wa woŋ wù Nyo le gɛ. Mɛ gɛh muh wù gɛ̀ ja fo wu to fɛkuu fɛnɛ, muh wunɛ nyu muh wù jee che le Mwamuh.
No Musɛ gɛ̀ shɛŋshɛ yo yi ba gɛ fɛ bɛ kichwa yi kite le nchvuuŋ, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no ba kɛme ki ba ge ba shɛŋshɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh,
wu lɛ mo nyu yɛɛŋ wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, tu wu lé wu kɛ̂mɛ kinche kì kage gɛ.
Nyo gɛ̀ bee wu koŋ woŋ kfunɛ baaŋ, wu tuŋ Mwa ye wù wu mumwaa, wu lɛ le yɛɛŋ wù leesɛ fitele ye ye le, mwɛdɛ gɛ lɛsɛ gɛ, wu kɛmɛ nyu kinche kì kage gɛ.
Gɛ Nyo gɛ̀ tuŋ Mwa ye yi woŋ kfunɛ le lɛ wu to wu sa bamii ba gwe nsa gɛ. Nyo gɛ̀ tuŋ lɛ wu to wu bvusɛ lo bo fede yi Mwa ye le.
Muh wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi wu le gɛ wu nyu wu ge wu gwe nsa gɛ. Geenɛ muh wù baaŋ leesɛ gɛ fitele yi wu le gɛ le wu gwe wa nsa, nje wu baaŋ leesɛ gɛ̀ fitele yi jee chi Mwa Nyo wu mɛ gɛh wu gɛ.
Ba lé ba gê ba sûunɛ nsa yi yinɛ je le, nje n'yulɛ le wu to yi woŋ kfunɛ le, bamii koŋe gɛh fiboo nyu kijibɛ fede n'yulɛ. Bo koŋe noo nje gee chiboo le chì befe.
Muh wuchii wù gee gee chì befe wu to wu banɛ n'yulɛ, gɛ taŋlo wù bu fɛ n'yulɛ le gɛ, lɛ keefɛ gee che yɛ̂nɛ fɛ waaŋ gɛ.
Geenɛ muh wù gee fiɛɛ fì kooji to wu too fɛ n'yulɛ le, lɛ gee che dûunyi lɛ le chi muh wu Nyo.”

content: Joŋ jɛmɛ lɛ Jiso kuge wu fede wu
Ajiŋ ayu le, Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ja bo gɛɛne kimbe kimi ki Judia le. Bɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo tu bo nyu yo wu leese bamii a joo.
Joŋ tɛ gɛ̀ leese bamii a joo ntɛ wu Ɛnoŋ le mbebe wu Salim le nje joo gɛ̀ bee fo baaŋ. Bamii too wu leese bo a joo.
Finɛ gɛ̀ bee ba baaŋ a leesɛ gɛ wa wu yeh yi ncha le gɛ.
Booŋ ba Joŋ ba ŋgoo bamu bɛ muh wu Bajuu wumu gɛ̀ ja bo kɛ kintɛɛnyɛ kune ye yì ba chuge ki ba yuude a Nyo jii.

Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Joŋ ja bo gɛɛŋ fɛ Joŋ le, bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Labai, muh wɛɛ wù gɛ̀ bee bena wu fɛ Joo yì Jodaŋ le wuŋ kwege wù wo gɛ̀ jɛme baaŋ kune wu nɛ, yɛŋ nɛ wu wege wu leese bamii a joo, bamii bachii gɛɛne gɛ wa nyu fɛ wu le.”
Joŋ chvuu bo le lɛ, “Gɛ muh taŋlo wù nyu fiɛɛ njɛ ge Nyo wù nyu fi sɛŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ kibɛɛ taŋlo bɛŋ bɛɛ jiŋ yi nsa waŋ lɛ ŋgɛ̀ mbee njɛmɛ lɛ gɛ nyume mɛ wù le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka gɛ. Geenɛ ba gɛ̀ tuŋ mɛ lɛ nsa wù fwe.

Muh bvuguu le muh wù kɛme kwɛse wù fwɛŋ. Nsaŋ yi muh bvuguu wù lɛme mbebe yi muh bvuguu wɛɛ le wu yuge jɛ ye, wu to wu laŋeye baaŋ no wu yuge jɛ ye. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no nle mɛɛse n'yisɛ bɛ kinlaŋye.
Wu kɛme ki wu kû wu gɛ̂ɛŋ lo fwe, ntû lo jiŋ.
Muh wù ja fɛwe wu kuge wu fede bamii bachii. Muh wu yi nshɛŋ le, le muh wu yi nshɛŋ le, wu jɛme mwɛɛ nyu mu yi nshɛŋ le. Muh wù ja woŋ wù fɛwe le, wu kuge wu fede bamii bachii,
wu bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa yi mwɛɛ nyu mu wu le wu yɛŋ wa wu ka wu yu. Geenɛ, gɛ muh nyu yu wù bɛmɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme le gɛ.
Muh wù bɛmɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme duunyi lɛ wu toone fiɛɛ fì le lɛ Nyo jɛme nchiɛɛŋ.
Muh wù Nyo tuŋ to wu jɛme gɛh nyu jɛ yi Nyo, nje Nyo le wu nya Kiyo ke wu le nfee sɛŋ.
Chiji Mwa wu koŋe Mwa, wu mo wu nya mwɛɛ munchii chiaaŋ ye le.
Muh wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi Mwa le wù kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ. Muh wù baaŋ yu gɛ wu le gɛ, gɛ wu nyu wu kɛmɛ kinche gɛ. Wuwɛɛ muh le shɛ́ŋ yi Nyo toonyi bɛ wu baaŋ.”
